issues.description: Method SealSaloon.calculateTotalPrice(Meal): the problem statement (UML and text) requires this method to return a double (double precision for financial calculations), but the solution implementation declares and returns an int. This mismatch between the specified return type (double) and the implemented return type (int) will confuse students about the correct signature to implement and may cause test or grading mismatches.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the implementation with the problem statement: change the method signature in SealSaloon to public static double calculateTotalPrice(Meal meal) and modify the implementation to accumulate and return a double (e.g., use double sum = 0.0; sum += ingredient.getPrice(); return sum;). Update any callers or tests that rely on the method to accept a double return value.
